proposals.evidence: Turner places Oriya lahaṛi/lahaṛā wave in the second *lahaḍi branch, distinguished by retroflex ṛ from plain-r laharī. Bhatri leheṛa wind is a qualified semantic extension from wave/surge to gust; the recorded retroflex consonant supports this branch, while plain-r lehera is excluded.
